links.outcome: Output disparities when patient demographic attributes varied in clinical vignette prompts across eight LLMs
links.effect: Counterfactual demographic red-teaming revealed various disparities across protected groups; larger models were not necessarily less biased and medical fine-tuning did not consistently outperform general-purpose models.
links.quote: Our experiments reveal various disparities across protected groups.

links.outcome: Fairness of LLM outputs across protected patient subgroups in clinical decision support
links.effect: LLMs demonstrated significant social biases in clinical scenarios, influenced by model architecture and prompt engineering.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrate significant social biases in clinical scenarios that are influenced by model architecture and prompt engineering.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to reduce biased LLM outputs
Comparing prompt phrasing effects on bias

screen.reason: Empirical study testing bias across LLMs in clinical QA datasets, explicitly comparing prompting strategies (zero-shot vs chain of thought) as a safeguard to mitigate bias.
